answer.rationale: Memory 57 is most directly aligned: it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm, though it omits margin, incentive cost, and longer-term effects. Memory 44 provides strong evidence on pipeline quality for enterprise sales-assisted flows but omits closed-won revenue, retention, and sales efficiency. Memories 31 and 86 show durable/early activation and adoption improvements, useful leading indicators but without qualified-revenue or retention evidence. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift in the relevant price-sensitive SMB segment, but promotional pricing omits margin, retention, and durability. Memory 91 reports improved engagement and first meaningful action, but omits revenue, customer quality, retention, and durability.
